title: Screenshot Webhook Sender
description: This is a simple mod that allows automatic uploading of screenshots to any type of webhook like discord, fluxer, slack and most others.
body:
This will send any screenshot you take in minecraft to a webhook of your choosing it could be discord, fluxer, slack or any other service.

**Usage**
1. Set the webhook via modmenu settings
2. Take a screenshot ingame with F2
3. Check your discord channel!
